citations.text: In this ongoing, multicenter, double-blind, parallel-group, randomized, placebo-controlled trial, we assessed the safety and efficacy of a single dose of AZD7442 (two consecutive intramuscular injections; one each of tixagevimab and cilgavimab) for preexposure prophylaxis against Covid-19 in adults who had an increased risk of an inadequate response to Covid-19 vaccination, an increased risk of exposure to SARS-CoV-2, or both.

Participants were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive a single dose (two consecutive intramuscular injections, one containing tixagevimab and the other containing cilgavimab) of either 300 mg of AZD7442 or saline placebo, and they were followed for up to 183 days in the primary analysis.
